# Syntegreti — AI-First Enterprise Company

> AI-first company building products and shipping enterprise solutions from Hyderabad to the world.

## About

Syntegreti is an AI-first company that builds products and delivers enterprise services. We are a lean, focused, and growing team headquartered in Hyderabad, India, with global delivery capability. We serve six industries: Manufacturing, Lifesciences, Healthcare, Engineering, Insurance & Insurtech, and Banking.

Our tagline: Intelligence Through Connection.

## Products

### BetterSDLC
AI-powered software development lifecycle optimization. Replaces ad-hoc AI prompting with structured SDLC questionnaires across five roles: Business Analyst, Architect, Senior Developer, Developer, and Tester. Features context threading between phases, organizational learning via DSPy, and full compliance audit trails via Langfuse. Available as a VS Code extension, desktop app, CLI, and MCP server. For a 50-developer team: 40% less rework, 60% faster AI onboarding, $780k+ annual savings.

### Workweave
Agentic OS for Business. An intelligent operating system that orchestrates specialized AI agents across enterprise systems including Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Snowflake. Built on the VoltAgent framework with TypeScript. Features multi-agent orchestration, semantic RAG, voice and chat interfaces, smart escalation with human-in-the-loop. Delivers 97% faster context gathering, 40-60% ticket reduction, $72K annual savings per 1,000 users.

### Datacenter Solutions (ExaScale Thermal Intelligence)
AI-powered thermal management platform built on real exascale supercomputer operational data. Uses ensemble ML forecasting (ARIMA+Kalman, FFT Spectral, Holt-Winters, physics validation) delivering 95% prediction accuracy with 30-60 minute forecast horizons. Sub-products: ThermalVault (predictive thermal), HeatHarvest (waste heat recovery), ThermalTwin (digital twin), CarbonZero (ESG automation). Results: 15% cooling cost reduction, $2-5M annual savings per facility, 99.9% uptime guarantee.

## Services

### Catalyst Studio (MVP Factory)
Proprietary AI accelerator platform with a 4-week Proof of Tech methodology. Includes custom domain LLMs (Tax, Legal, Finance), Agentic RAG for unstructured document extraction, YOLO-based vision models, and smart prompting strategies. Sprint phases: Ideation → Tech Stack → Rapid Build → Toll Gate (Go/No-Go).

### Application Services
End-to-end application development, modernization, and managed services. Platforms: Salesforce, Workday. Custom: Java, .NET, MERN Stack, React Native. Services include packaged app implementation, global rollouts, migration, middleware integration, and AMS.

### Cloud Transformation
Strategy-led cloud migration and modernization on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Includes cloud strategy & roadmap, re-architecting, public/hybrid hosting, cloud security & governance, and cloud testing & QA. Technologies: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD.

### Data & AI
Full-stack data engineering and AI capabilities. Includes BI & data warehousing, ETL & data pipelines, data quality & governance, GenAI & LLM solutions, classical ML models, and rapid prototyping. Technologies: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenAI, Claude, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, DSPy, MLflow.

### Infrastructure Services
Enterprise infrastructure management including service desk & management, NOC/SOC operations, cybersecurity solutions, data center services, database & storage management, and infrastructure advisory. 24/7 coverage, SLA-driven L0-L3 support, AI-augmented ticket triage via Workweave.

## Case Studies

### AI Scheduling Assistant (Home Services)
Omni-channel AI assistant deployed across Voice, Web Chat, and SMS. Built with Claude Sonnet 3.5 and DSPy optimization. Features weather-aware scheduling and mandatory review-confirm loops. Results: $80-120K annual savings, 3-minute avg call (vs 8 min manual), 0 wait time (vs 15 min), 40% human call volume reduction, 99% availability.

### AI IT Support Assistant (Enterprise IT)
Multi-agent orchestration system using VoltAgent framework and GPT-4o. Specialized agents for ServiceNow, RAG search, and ticket escalation. Omni-channel support via Voice (VAPI) and Web Chat. Results: $72K annual savings per 1,000 users, 40-60% L1 ticket reduction, 2-minute resolution (vs 4 hours), 24/7 availability, 6-8 week implementation.
